findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: A can of mixed vegetables and a can of tomato paste stored on shelves in the dry storage area were observed to be swollen, indicating potential bacterial activity. Also, two cans of mandarin oranges were observed to have dents along the seams. The inspector discussed the need to remove swollen and dented cans due to the risk of food contamination. CORRECTED - The operator removed the affected cans from the shelves. Ensure swollen or dented canned foods are not stored or served.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [PF]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: A sanitizer bucket was not observed in the kitchen during the inspection. Two sanitizer buckets testing at 400 ppm were observed in the dinning hall near the kitchen. The inspector educated and instructed the operator to ensure a sanitizer bucket is available and maintained in the kitchen during all hours of operation, while the facility could still maintain the sanitizer buckets in the dinning hall. CORRECTED - The operator prepared a sanitizer bucket, which tested at 400 ppm. A sanitizer bucket should always be in the kitchen during all hours of operation for sanitizing surfaces and equipments.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [PF]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The microwave in the serving station at the dinning hall was observed to have food debris and soil accumulation. The inspector instructed the operator to ensure the microwave is cleaned to sight and touch and kept free of food debris and soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed freezers 1, 4, and 5 in the storage area to have a build up of ice on the inside. Discussed defrosting with PIC. Ensure these units are defrosted regularly enough to remove the ice. Ice is not considered smooth, durable, or easily cleanable.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The inner flap of the ice machine has a significant accumulation of pathogenic growth observed. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. The location was cleaned during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The dish machine maximum registering thermometer reads 153F when placed through the dish machine. Building maintenance was called. The high water level float and thermometer had been recently replaced on the machine. Maintenance adjusted the temperature and was able to have the machine adjusted so that the maximum registering thermometer reads 161.5F. The hot water wash and rinse cycle temperatures are within range. The violation was corrected on site. 

 

4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 

The fan in the kitchen is observed to have some dust accumulation, also the upright freezer holding beef patties has frost accumulation. Clean non food contact surfaces at appropriate frequencies. The fan was cleaned on site.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Observed PIC to wash hands incorrectly. No barrier was used to turn off the faucet handles. Discussed with PIC. PIC indicated she normally uses her elbow to dispense the paper towels, dries hands, then turns off the faucet handles with the paper towels. Ensure staff is aware proper hand washing techniques. COS.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

(REPEAT) Observed multiple freezers in the back storage area to have a large accumulation of frost build-up. Ensure routine cleaning. Discussed with PIC. Ensure to defrost the freezers before next routine inspection. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 2/1/22.

findings.comment:
3-307.11: FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306. 

Observed ponding water at the base of two reach-in coolers. Rags are being used to collect the water. Ensure repairs to both coolers before next routine inspection.

findings.comment:
4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

Observed multiple chest and reach-in freezers in back storage and dry storage areas to have large accumulations of frost. Discussed routine cleaning with PIC.
